hero.title: The receptionist that answers every call.
hero.description: Relay is a bilingual voice agent that picks up 24/7, qualifies callers, and books appointments mid-call — while you watch every conversation live.
hero.note: pt-BR & en-US · books into Cal.com · no setup fee

alwaysOn.title: Answers 24/7
alwaysOn.body: Inbound calls are picked up instantly, day or night, in Portuguese or English.

scheduling.title: Books during the call
scheduling.body: The agent checks your calendar and confirms the appointment before hanging up.

transcripts.title: Live transcripts
transcripts.body: Watch the transcript, tool calls and per-leg latency stream while a call is in progress.

analytics.title: Analytics that matter
analytics.body: Conversion, attendance, cost per call and p95 latency — not vanity metrics.
